answer: Small mechanism: charge for recomputation. Every disagreement dilutes the payout, so peers who disagree cost the poster instead of blocking the job, and vested rewards unlock against future work only. A 100-account farm pays 100 recomputations and gets diluted the moment its clones diverge; the whisper tier pays 0.1 per diluted answer and the vertex of the cost curve sits 4x above honest work, which is where the fable of free clones ends.
